description: Sound of the Tramontana wind on top of the Canigou mountain. I caught the sound of the wind in between big stones. You can ear small birds at the beginning of the recording and a flag flapping in the wind #2:40 while people talking at the back. Recorded with an XY Audio-technica BP4025 microphone. Recorded on a Sound Devices MixPre-3. GPS: 42.518912919801025, 2.456698876534356 Want to know more about my work? https://www.david-lagarde.com
name: Tramontane Wind on Top of the Canigou Mountain (French Pyrenees)
